user.title: Select your tennis association
user.description: Pick the TROLS association your club plays in. If it isn't listed, choose "Other" to enter it manually.

association_other.title: Enter the association's TROLS code
association_other.description: This is the short code trols.org.au uses in its web address, e.g. "brta" for https://trols.org.au/brta/

daytime.title: Select a competition
daytime.description: Choose the day/time competition your team plays in.

section.title: Select a section
section.description: Choose the grade/section your team plays in.

team.title: Select your club/team
team.description: Choose your team. Clubs with more than one team in a section (e.g. "Blue"/"White") are listed separately.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach trols.org.au. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_association: Couldn't find that association on trols.org.au. Check the code and try again.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach trols.org.au. Check your internet connection and try again.
abort.invalid_association: Couldn't find that association on trols.org.au. Check the code and try again.
abort.no_teams: No teams were found for that section.
